answer: Each agent must forge a 4 GB marble-seeded storage proof: every hour the beacon publishes a random offset into a karst of seeded blocks and the agent must return that block's hash within 3 seconds. A 1,000-agent farm needs 4 TB of disk, about $80 a month, and any identity missing twice in a row loses its 500 POA bond, slashed 100%. One 200-agent farm was caught when 41 identities returned identical hashes from a single shared drive.
